text.en: This Act may be cited as the Agricultural Pests and Short title Noxious Plants Act.

In this Act unless the context otherwise requires - pest" means any pest which His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan in Council by notification in the Gazette declares to be a dangerous pest for the purposes of this Act; means attacked by or infected or affected with any pest; "inspecting officer" means any inspecting officer under section 3 and includes the Director of Agriculture; "land" includes things attached to the earth or permanently fastened to anything atached to the earth and premises; plant" means any plant which His Majesty in Council by notification in the Gazette declares to be a noxious plant for the purposes of this Act and includes the seed and every part of such plant; includes a lessee or tenant and a cultior person in actual possession, management orcontrolofanyland; B.L.R.O. 1/1984 LAWS 01' BRUNEI of Customs" shall have the same meaning as in the Customs Act; means the registered proprietor of any land; "pest" includes any insect, invertebrate animal, rodent, vermin, fungus, parasite, bacteria, virus or disease, destructive or injurious, directly or indirectly, to any plant and includes the eggs of any pest; means any species of vegetable and any part of a plant whether living or dead and includes the stem, root, leaf, flower, fruit or any part or product whatsoever of any plant whether severed or attached; "quarantining" means isolating any land and premises for the purposes of this Act or of any rules made thereunder so that there shall be no comor traffic with any other land and premises except in accordance with this Act or any rules made thereunder;
His Majesty in Council may appoint in writing any of inspecting officer of the Department of Agriculture to be an inspecting officer for the purposes of this Act.

(a) if the person to whom it is addressed is within Brunei, the notice or order may be delivered to him or left with some adult member of his family than a servant) residing with him; or -
